items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: >> [(note)] Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery

ctx.x: Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 79 pp.

Today is November 8, 2010. This is the Smithsonian NEA Jazz Oral History interview with Ellis Marsalis, conducted by Anthony Brown, in his home at 3818 Hickory Street in New Orleans, Louisiana. Good evening, Ellis Marsalis.
